meta.name: multi-cloud-architecture
meta.description: Design multi-cloud architectures using a decision framework to select and integrate services across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI. Use when building multi-cloud systems, avoiding vendor lock-in, or leveraging best-of-breed services from multiple providers.

copy.tagline: 设计多云架构,规避厂商锁定
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要同时在多家云上搭建系统
copy.tagline_en: Design multi-cloud systems and avoid vendor lock-in
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building across multiple cloud providers

howto.what: 它按一套决策框架,帮你在 AWS、Azure、GCP、OCI 之间挑选并组合服务,产出多云架构方案:计算/存储/数据库服务对照表、四种多云模式、成本对比和分阶段迁移计划。
howto.when: 当你设计多云策略、在云厂商之间迁移,或为特定工作负载挑选云服务时触发。

say.text: 帮我对比 AWS、Azure、GCP 的 Kubernetes 托管服务
say.note: 输出服务对照与选择建议

say.text: 设计一个主用 AWS、灾备用 Azure 的多云架构
say.note: 给出单主多云容灾方案

say.text: 给我一份从 AWS 迁移到 GCP 的分阶段计划
say.note: 按评估、试点、迁移、优化四阶段输出

howto.what_en: It uses a decision framework to pick and combine services across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI, producing multi-cloud designs: service comparison, four patterns, cost comparison, and a phased migration plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you design a multi-cloud strategy, migrate between cloud providers, or pick cloud services for a specific workload.

say_en.text: Compare the managed Kubernetes services on AWS, Azure, and GCP
say_en.note: Gives a comparison and a pick

say_en.text: Design a multi-cloud architecture with primary AWS and DR Azure
Give me a phased plan to migrate from AWS to GCP
